audit.method: the BOE's consolidated-text page (www.boe.es/buscar/act.php?id=<id>, HTML, the text as the BOE publishes it for readers) read for norms published or read this check, and compared with the files at the tip, letters and digits: every block of the page found in the files, and at most 3% of the files' letters not on the page as such (heading blocks the XML keeps and the page no longer shows)

verify.method: each norm's consolidated XML read again from the BOE (api/legislacion-consolidada/id/<id>, 5 reads, 2.5 s apart), rendered by the repository's own builder (es_ccaa.py and gitlaw_common), and the text in force today compared with the files at the tip of main, git blob by git blob (byte for byte); a rotating sweep reads every held norm within 30 days (5 of 121 swept this check)
